title.narrative: for implementation of the Leave No One Behind Partnership in Kenya and beyond

description.narrative: The International Civil Society Centre (ICSC) supports international civil society organizations to maximize their impact for a sustainable and more equitable world. ICSC’s vision is the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) with the ambition to end all forms of poverty, achieve social justice, and tackle climate change — while ensuring that no one is left behind. ICSC’s Leave No One Behind Partnership is a global enterprise that has set up national coalitions in five pilot countries (Bangladesh, India, Kenya, Nepal, and Vietnam), bringing together national NGOs and civic platforms, as well as community-based organizations that want to make SDG implementation more inclusive and accountable toward those who are furthest behind in society — making their voices heard and count. This grant will scale up the coalition’s reach in Kenya, continue building the capacity of citizens, grassroots organizations, and marginalized groups in generating and using community-driven data to foster their participation in relevant public discourses and political forums like the national SDG process, while fostering international coalition building through the global Collaborative on Citizen Data. (Strategy: Evidence-Informed Policymaking).
